summary: Bronson's only recorded statement on the topic came on March 13, 2024, when as Anchorage mayor he issued a statement supporting Israel after his campaign signs were vandalized, describing the perpetrators as pro-Hamas. His campaign platform addresses Alaska energy, infrastructure, housing, education, and public safety with no reference to Israel or Palestine. That single pro-Israel statement, framed around his campaign materials being targeted by Hamas-aligned individuals, places him on the Israel-supporting side.
